description: Visual data transformation using Power Query (M language). Connects to sources, applies transformations (filter, merge, pivot), and loads results into Fabric destinations. Also known as Dataflow Gen2.

definition_parts.description: The Power Query M script (starts with 'section Section1;'). Holds the queries/transformations. Verified live.

notes: A Dataflow definition is MULTI-PART: queryMetadata.json (required) + mashup.pq (the M script). Sending mashup.pq alone fails; queryMetadata.json is required. Verified live.
fabio dataflow update-definition passes a full envelope through verbatim, so the reliable pattern is: get-definition -> edit the parts -> update-definition --file <envelope.json>.
Two job types: 'execute' (runs dataflow) and 'applyChanges' (applies pending definition changes)
Run supports --wait with polling (terminal states: Completed, Failed, Cancelled)
execute-query returns binary Apache Arrow IPC stream (save to --file)
discover-parameters returns M parameters from the dataflow
Validate offline before pushing: fabio item validate-definition --type Dataflow --dir <folder>
